basic_details.scholarship_name: Taiwan ICDF International Higher Education Scholarship
basic_details.offering_entity: International Cooperation and Development Fund (Taiwan ICDF)
basic_details.host_institutions_covered: 23 partner universities in Taiwan (National Taiwan University, National Tsing Hua, National Cheng Kung, National Yang Ming Chiao Tung, National Central University)
basic_details.major_restrictions: Open to designated English-taught programs across Science & Technology, Agriculture, Public Health & Medicine, Business & Management, and Humanities & Social Sciences.
basic_details.number_of_awards_total: ~200 to 250 scholarships awarded annually across partner developing countries
basic_details.number_of_awards_pakistan: Open to Pakistan as an eligible partner developing country (~10 to 15 Pakistani scholars selected annually)
basic_details.duration_of_scholarship: Bachelor's (max 4 years); Master's (max 2 years); PhD (max 4 years)

nationality_requirements: Citizens of eligible partner countries (including Pakistan)
eligibility_requirements.academic_qualifications: 12 years for Bachelor's; 16 years for Master's; 18 years for PhD from an HEC-recognized institution.
eligibility_requirements.grading_conversion_notes: Minimum 3.00 / 4.00 CGPA or 75%+ marks; good academic background in chosen field.
eligibility_requirements.subject_background_prerequisites: Prerequisites corresponding to designated ICDF partner university degree programs.
eligibility_requirements.current_education_status: Graduated or in final year of degree.
eligibility_requirements.work_experience_notes: Prior work experience in public service or development sectors valued.

english_proficiency.notes: IELTS Academic 6.0+, TOEFL iBT 75+, or university English proficiency certificate verifying prior study was conducted in English.

eligibility_requirements.other_language_requirements: None; all designated programs taught 100% in English.
eligibility_requirements.special_eligibility_categories: Development impact and bilateral cultural exchange.
eligibility_requirements.previous_scholarship_restrictions: Cannot hold another scholarship from the government of Taiwan concurrently.

tuition_fee.details: 100% full tuition and credit fees covered directly by Taiwan ICDF.

admission_application_fee.details: Partner universities waive or reimburse application fees for ICDF scholars.

accommodation.details: Free standard on-campus student dormitory accommodation covered by Taiwan ICDF.

monthly_stipend.details: Monthly subsistence allowance paid directly to student to cover food and living expenses.
monthly_stipend.amount: Undergrad: NT$ 15,000/mo; Master: NT$ 18,000/mo (~PKR 160,000/mo); PhD: NT$ 20,000/mo (~PKR 180,000/mo)

airfare.details: Economy class return flights between Pakistan and Taiwan booked via most direct route.

visa_fee.details: Taiwan resident visa fee paid by applicant at Taipei Trade Office.

health_insurance.details: National Health Insurance (NHI) and student accidental insurance fully covered.

books_and_materials_allowance.details: Textbook costs covered directly through university partner department.

research_funding_conference_grant.details: Research laboratory resources accessible across partner university labs.

university_and_program_options.single_or_multiple_universities: Apply for one program among the designated Taiwan ICDF partner universities.
participating_institutions: National Yang Ming Chiao Tung University (NYCU)
university_and_program_options.university_rankings_scope: National Taiwan University is World Top 70; premier semiconductor and engineering ecosystem.
available_majors: Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, Semiconductor Technology, Mechanical Engineering, Tropical Agriculture, Aquaculture, Global Health, Biomedical Informatics, Civil Engineering, International Business, Environment & Sustainable Development
university_and_program_options.program_duration: Bachelor's: 4 years; Master's: 2 years; PhD: 4 years
university_and_program_options.admission_requirements_summary: Two-step application: Submit online application on the Taiwan ICDF portal; simultaneously submit university admission application to the partner university.
university_and_program_options.easiest_hardest_institutions_guidance: Must apply to both the ICDF portal AND the chosen partner university before their respective deadlines.
university_and_program_options.strategic_program_match_advice: Semiconductor, Electrical Engineering, and Agriculture programs in Taiwan are globally renowned.

application_process_roadmap.portal_system_name: Taiwan ICDF Online Scholarship Application System
application_process_roadmap.account_creation_instructions: Register on the ICDF online application portal (Opens January), fill out application form, upload documents, and print application summary.
step_by_step_workflow: 1. Choose eligible program from the official Taiwan ICDF partner program list (Opens January 1).
2. Complete online application on Taiwan ICDF portal by March 15.
3. Submit separate online application for admission to the chosen partner university by the university's deadline.
4. Submit printed application form and required documents to the nearest designated Taipei Trade Office / Mission if required.
5. Partner universities review academic credentials and submit recommendations to ICDF in April/May.
6. Final list of scholarship recipients announced by Taiwan ICDF by June 10.
7. Process Taiwan resident visa and prepare for departure in August/September.
application_process_roadmap.university_vs_scholarship_routing: Dual application: Apply on ICDF portal AND apply to partner university.
application_process_roadmap.recommendation_letters_submission_method: Uploaded directly by candidate on the portal or sent via email.
application_process_roadmap.personal_statement_prompts: Study Plan / Statement of Purpose detailing academic background, reasons for choosing Taiwan, and future contributions to national development.
application_process_roadmap.study_plan_research_proposal_requirement: Research proposal required for PhD applicants.
application_process_roadmap.interview_format_details: Partner university or Taipei Representative Office may conduct video interviews in April/May.
application_process_roadmap.application_fee_amount: $0 on ICDF portal; university application fees usually waived.
application_process_roadmap.attestation_requirements: Diplomas and transcripts must be authenticated by HEC and MOFA Pakistan, and verified by Taipei Economic and Cultural Center.
application_process_roadmap.final_submission_method: Online via ICDF portal and university portal.

required_documents_checklist.specification: Completed and signed application form printed from ICDF portal
Notarized copies of educational diplomas and mark sheets
Letters from university professors or employers on official letterhead
IELTS Academic (6.0+), TOEFL iBT (75+), or official MOI certificate

important_dates_timeline.annual_cycle_notes: Application window is January 1 to March 15 each year. Final results announced by June 10.

selection_process_and_weights.selection_panel_composition: Joint assessment by partner university admissions committee and the Taiwan ICDF Scholarship Committee.
selection_process_and_weights.evaluation_methodology: Two-tier review: Partner university checks academic admissibility; ICDF confirms scholarship award.

competitiveness_profile.total_annual_applicants: ~3,000 to 4,000 applicants across all partner countries
competitiveness_profile.acceptance_rate_pakistan: ~4% to 5% (Favorable conversion for strong STEM profiles)
competitiveness_profile.typical_academic_and_research_profile: Solid graduates with degrees in engineering, agriculture, IT, or public health seeking world-class technical education.
competitiveness_profile.common_backgrounds_of_winners: Graduates of Pakistani universities (NUST, UET Lahore, Faisalabad Agricultural University, COMSATS, Quaid-i-Azam).
competitiveness_profile.high_representation_countries: Southeast Asian, South Asian, African, and Latin American partner countries.

fake_websites_and_scams: Agents claiming to sell Taiwan ICDF application forms.
red_flags_and_warnings.application_fee_warning: The ICDF scholarship application is 100% free of charge.
red_flags_and_warnings.agent_and_intermediary_warnings: Never work through commercial consultants; submit directly on the official ICDF portal.
hidden_costs_breakdown: Initial pocket money before first stipend transfer.
misleading_claims_debunked: MYTH: You must speak Mandarin Chinese. (Fact: All designated Taiwan ICDF scholarship programs are taught 100% in English).
MYTH: You only need to apply on the ICDF portal. (Fact: You MUST also submit a university admission application to the partner university).
official_vs_unofficial_discrepancies: External blogs state the stipend is NT$ 30,000; the official rate is NT$ 15,000 for BS, NT$ 18,000 for MS, and NT$ 20,000 for PhD alongside free tuition and dorm.

scholarship_obligations_and_terms.minimum_gpa_maintenance: Must maintain minimum academic average required by the host university (typically 70%+ or GPA 3.0/4.0).
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.attendance_requirements: Full-time physical enrollment on campus in Taiwan.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.academic_progress_monitoring: Host universities submit semester grade reports to Taiwan ICDF.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.work_restrictions_during_study: Scholars may work part-time up to 20 hours/week with a work permit during semesters per Taiwan regulations.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.home_country_return_obligation: None; scholars can seek employment in Taiwan's technology sector post-graduation under Taiwan work permit schemes.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.repayment_clawback_conditions: Failing academic requirements or expulsion leads to termination of scholarship.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.extension_policy: No extensions beyond normal program duration.
